canonical_project: Ogero Data Centers (Ras Beirut / Bir Hassan)
notes: Two Ogero data center facilities at Ras Beirut/Bir Hassan (Beirut) fully installed and commissioned by ESS: Liebert N+N precision cooling, FM200 fire suppression, environmental monitoring, access control, raised floor; first phase 15 racks with expansion provision. DCD (Aug 2021) documents Ogero running these facilities on backup generators during Lebanon's diesel/fuel crisis, confirming their operation. No public MW capacity figure.
